name: Orval Keith Simons
milestones: Born 30 Oct 1929, Lynden, Whatcom Co, Washington
Died 21 Jul 1979, Spokane, Spokane Co, Washington

Obituary of Irene Simons, Tri-City Herald, 15 Oct 2017 (Legacy.com)
Washington State Archives, Digital Archives, Department of Health, Marriage Index, 1969-2022

notes: Open question: an Orvel K. Simons married Ruth E. Bates (born Connor) on 12 Mar 1977 in Franklin County (Department of Health marriage index). If this is Orval, he and Irene had divorced before his death in 1979.
A witness, as Orvel K. Simons, at the wedding of his brother Glen and Mary Patricia Walker at Kennewick on 27 Jul 1958 (Franklin County marriage certificate no. 9306).
Born 30 Oct 1929 and died 21 Jul 1979 at Spokane (Washington death records, as Orvel K. Simons). Ed Simons's tree gives his birthplace as Bellingham.
